events.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Napoli 1, Bodø/Glimt 0. Matteo Politano (Napoli) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Leonardo Spinazzola with a cross.
Delay in match (Bodø/Glimt).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Napoli 1, Bodø/Glimt 1. Jens Petter Hauge (Bodø/Glimt) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Sondre Fet.
Goal! Napoli 2, Bodø/Glimt 1. Scott McTominay (Napoli) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Kevin De Bruyne with a through ball.
First Half ends, Napoli 2, Bodø/Glimt 1.
Second Half begins Napoli 2, Bodø/Glimt 1.
Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Noa Lang (Napoli) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Napoli. Stanislav Lobotka replaces Frank Anguissa.
Goal! Napoli 2, Bodø/Glimt 2. Andreas Helmersen (Bodø/Glimt) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Sondre Fet.
Goal! Napoli 3, Bodø/Glimt 2. Scott McTominay (Napoli) header from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Matteo Politano with a cross.
Substitution, Bodø/Glimt. Ola Brynhildsen replaces Andreas Helmersen.
Substitution, Napoli. Mathías Olivera replaces Matteo Politano.
Substitution, Napoli. Giovane replaces Noa Lang.
Substitution, Napoli. Sam Beukema replaces Leonardo Spinazzola.
Substitution, Bodø/Glimt. Ulrik Saltnes replaces Sondre Auklend.
Substitution, Bodø/Glimt. Haitam Aleesami replaces Jostein Gundersen.
Substitution, Bodø/Glimt. Joel Mvuka replaces Ole Didrik Blomberg.
Substitution, Bodø/Glimt. Isak Määttä replaces Fredrik Bjørkan.
Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Own Goal by Odin Bjørtuft, Bodø/Glimt. Napoli 4, Bodø/Glimt 2.
Goal! Napoli 4, Bodø/Glimt 3. Sondre Fet (Bodø/Glimt) header from very close range to the bottom left corner following a corner.
Second Half ends, Napoli 4, Bodø/Glimt 3.
